title: A clear correction restores a promise’s scope

captions.physics: Correcting shared conclusions directly and kindly
captions.energy: Removing an expanded promise’s false foundation
captions.emotions: Feeling proportion between agreement and expectations

meaning: You can correct a shared conclusion directly and remove an expanded promise’s false foundation, feeling proportion between agreement and expectations without denying a wish for greater support.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Sun in the physical position appears in a direct friendly correction of a shared conclusion. The Tower in energy supports readiness to remove an expanded promise’s false foundation. Justice in emotions brings proportion between agreement and expectations. You can name what was actually accepted without devaluing another wish. Clarity restores a particular word’s scope rather than determining which request is now permissible in every circumstance.

For example, someone says, “I am glad we talked, but I did not promise to answer for you”. Earlier discussion had treated joint preparation as permission to speak with one voice. **Shared conversation creates no unnamed obligation**. You can remove this false basis and separately ask about actual readiness. Proportion emerges: participation that occurred is recognised without automatic expansion. Wanting a joint reply remains a possible request rather than becoming inappropriate simply because it was not previously accepted.

Difficulty arises if every request for broader participation is heard as repeating the old mistake after an accurate correction. Proportion becomes a ban on discussing new agreement. Constructive Tower energy helps remove false support from this particular conclusion. You can reject an unnamed debt and freely consider another question; clarity requires no permanent restriction to earlier participation’s scope, while a request does not breach agreement simply because it has not yet received an answer.
